packageRules.description: One update for all workflow actions, kept pinned to commit SHAs.
gradle/actions v6 moves caching into a proprietary component under separate terms of use. Staying on v5 until that is a deliberate decision.
@types/vscode must match the oldest VS Code in engines.vscode, or typecheck accepts APIs that fail at runtime there. Raise both together, by hand.
@types/node follows the Node that the oldest supported VS Code ships (Node 20 for 1.90), not the newest Node.
